additional_info.subject: RE: ID0408294-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / R1 170001369] Charging issue on DC2 CRM:00641001125
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
Hope you are doing well,
As per the reported issue, we have reviewed the logs and identified that the outlet went into an out-of-order state due to a switching matrix fault. This fault was triggered by the feedback from contactor
MG1-MG2_QA9-10
being stuck.
Please refer to the error flags below, which indicate that the switching matrix fault was caused by the
DC_Contactor_MG1-MG2_QA9-10
:
2025-02-19T07:51:54.962362+00:00
– PLC-Error-Flag 'Converter_Group_DC2' changed from
false
('CG okay') to
true
('switching matrix fault').
2025-02-19T07:51:55.718170+00:00
– PLC-Error-Flag 'DC_Contactor_MG1-MG2_QA9-10' changed from
true
('contactor stuck at ON feedback') to
true
('contactor stuck at ON feedback, waiting for reset').
Additionally, another error was logged at the same time:
2025-02-19T07:51:54.963920+00:00
– PLC-Error-Flag 'Outlet_DC2_codes' changed from
false
('DC2 Errorcode:0') to
true
('DC2 Errorcode:7.4').
This error indicates that the outlet was not ready due to a
primary converter group error
. However, after some time, the error reset, and the outlet became operational again.
Sequence of Error Resolution:
2025-02-19T08:15:05.149030+00:00
– 'Converter_Group_DC2' changed from
true
('switching matrix fault') to
false
('CG okay').
2025-02-19T08:15:05.169950+00:00
– 'DC2 StatusCode' changed from
"NOT_READY"
to
"READY"
.
2025-02-19T08:15:44.439447+00:00
– 'setOutletLedState' changed to
ready 2
.
We have reviewed the recent logs and confirmed that
DC2 is now ready for the charger
. However, upon analyzing logs from the past month, we found that
contactor QA09-10
has repeatedly reported abnormal behavior.
Recommendation:
Based on the overall analysis, we recommend checking the
contactors
thoroughly, and if necessary, replacing them to prevent further issues.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
